verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only bulk XML file-submission schemas and batch enrollment specs that are available by emailed request, which are file-exchange formats rather than a documented public API. The probe found the business-tax application is an interactive login shell, with transactions behind an authenticated web session; no API endpoints, reference docs or developer access are evidenced. missing for 10: documented public API endpoints, API reference documentation, programmatic authentication (keys/tokens), publicly available specs, independent corroboration of programmatic use.
